The Great 
Migration.
hero.description: From the Golden Age of hospitality to modern corporate logistics. A legacy at the service of those who demand the impeccable.

chapter1.label: Chapter I — 1924
chapter1.title:
The Winter 
Season.

text.p1: All excellence is born from a journey.
text.p2: LA Global began humbly, acting directly in the field, learning from every operation, every challenge, and every client. This constant contact with operational reality allowed the company to evolve consistently, accumulating experience in various environments — from residential to specialised logistics — until naturally reaching the corporate market.
text.p3: This evolution, which we call The Great Migration, does not represent a rupture, but a maturation process. It is the transition from an agile structure to an organisation prepared to address corporate operations with precision, responsibility, and strategic vision.
text.p4: Today, LA Global operates with clear methods, structured processes, and the capacity for anticipation. We understand that every company has its own challenges, distinct levels of requirement, and specific needs.
text.p5: It is this meticulous reading of the market that led to the creation of LA Global Corporate — a structure dedicated to professional projects of greater complexity, where rigour, confidentiality, and performance go hand in hand.
text.quote: LA Global's excellence is not a speech. It is the result of a path travelled.

ServicesPage.subservicesDescription: Discover the specialised operational modules included in this service.

f1.name: High-Rise Glass and Facade Cleaning
f1.desc: Your building facade is your first visual statement. Our specialised high-rise cleaning service combines industrial rope access, certified equipment, and strict safety protocols to restore complex glass and facade structures. We apply biodegradable products and material-safe techniques to deliver durable shine without damaging surfaces or the environment. The result is immediate: more natural light, more pleasant workplaces, and stronger property value. Contact us for a free facade assessment and a tailored quote.

f2.name: Corporate Concierge Service
f2.desc: Corporate concierge is redefining the workplace as a strategic service for employee wellbeing and operational efficiency. Inspired by luxury hospitality standards, it helps teams delegate personal and administrative tasks so they can focus on core responsibilities. Services are fully customisable, covering daily logistics, personal assistance, wellbeing support, travel and appointment management, and vehicle-related needs. The impact is measurable: stronger employer branding, higher productivity, fewer personal disruptions, and reduced absenteeism. Implementation can be physical, digital, or hybrid, with transparent and scalable cost models.

f3.name: Relocation Coordination
f3.desc: Relocation coordination turns a high-pressure move into a controlled and seamless transition. We act as end-to-end project managers: strategic planning, inventory audits, partner selection, administrative handling, and on-site supervision on moving day. Our approach serves both corporate and private contexts with the same level of precision: business continuity, protection of sensitive assets and data, organised setup of new spaces, and personalised follow-up until full operational readiness. You benefit from disciplined execution, real-time issue management, and cost optimisation throughout the process.

f4.name: Specialised Transport
f4.desc: Specialised transport is designed for your most sensitive and high-value assets. Beyond moving items, we ensure precision, protection, and full operational control at every stage. Our expertise serves healthcare equipment, industrial machinery, fine art, and critical IT infrastructure, with custom logistics built around each risk profile. Technical differentiators include an adapted fleet, air suspension, real-time tracking, custom packaging, and teams trained for complex handling conditions. The outcome is clear: reduced risk, regulatory compliance, value-based insurance coverage, and end-to-end coordination through a single point of contact.

f1.name: Professional Cleaning and Organisation
f1.desc: Excellence and daily peace of mind: an impeccable environment strengthens your brand image, reduces mental load, and supports higher productivity. Our service combines professional cleaning, functional space organisation, strict hygiene and disinfection standards, and full support for glazing, consumables, and waste handling. We operate with a strong eco-responsible approach through Ecolabel products, selective sorting, and responsible water and energy use. Our method includes a free initial assessment, discreet interventions aligned with your schedule, and recurring quality controls. You benefit from total flexibility, a single point of contact, and premium execution that keeps your workplace consistently organised and inspiring.

f2.name: Office Maintenance and Workspace Adjustments
f2.desc: In a fast-changing business environment, office maintenance is a strategic lever for performance, brand perception, and employee wellbeing. Our agile facility management approach helps you quickly reconfigure spaces, optimise resources, and maintain smooth daily operations. We also support sustainability goals through energy efficiency actions, selective waste sorting, and indoor air quality monitoring. For unexpected issues, our corrective maintenance service operates 24/7 with digital ticket tracking for full transparency. Flexible plans are tailored to your property footprint, with emergency response times ranging from 8 hours to under 4 hours. Contact us for a free office audit and a tailored proposal.

f3.name: Confidential Disposal and Recycling
f3.desc: Your data security is our absolute priority. We provide certified destruction of paper documents (DIN 66399, levels P-3 to P-7) and digital media, with a compliance certificate issued for every operation. Beyond paper, we also handle the secure dismantling and recycling of WEEE according to the strictest environmental standards, with 100% of materials routed to specialised recycling streams. Our 4-step methodology — audit, secure collection, high-security shredding, and traceable recycling — ensures GDPR compliance, uninterrupted chain of custody, and measurable CSR impact. Contact us for a free audit and a customised quote within 24 hours.

sub01.title: Goods Reception
sub01.description: Goods reception is far more than unloading: it is the operational gateway to logistics excellence. A well-executed inbound process protects inventory integrity, improves product conformity, and sets the pace for downstream performance. Our specialised cycle includes dock planning, controlled unloading, quantity and quality checks, non-conformity inspection, and immediate WMS registration for complete traceability. We leverage barcode/RFID scanning, integrated WMS workflows, and documented reservation protocols to reduce counting errors and legal exposure. Strategic gains are clear: higher inventory accuracy, lower damage-related costs, faster product availability for sales or production, and stronger compliance across your logistics operation.

sub02.title: Bonded Warehouse & Tax Exemption
sub02.description: Bonded warehousing is a strategic customs regime that allows imported goods to be stored under full tax suspension until nationalisation is required. This gives your company financial control by aligning fiscal disbursement with actual market demand. We manage the full operational cycle: customs setup, classification control, compliance governance, timeline monitoring, and release planning. Core mechanisms include suspension of import taxes during storage, partial nationalisation for pay-as-you-withdraw economics, and tax exemption when goods are re-exported. The model also allows selected in-warehouse operations such as conservation handling, commercial adaptation, and technical sampling. Strategic outcomes are immediate: stronger working capital, reduced logistics cost, faster market response, and legal certainty in monitored bonded facilities.

sub01.title: Showroom Assembly
sub01.description: Showroom assembly goes beyond product display: it creates immersive brand environments designed to convert attention into sales. We manage the full excellence cycle with precision: brand and objective analysis, detailed design, premium material and furniture selection, production and secure logistics, technical installation, and final scenography and merchandising. Our teams deliver tailored showroom solutions across luxury retail, interior design and furniture, automotive, and technology. The result is a high-impact environment that strengthens brand perception, drives purchase decisions, and supports multiple business uses including sales, training, and events.

sub02.title: Corporate Furniture Assembly and Installation
sub02.description: Corporate furniture assembly is more than putting parts together: it is about shaping workspaces that support performance, safety, and employee wellbeing. We convert your workplace project into a fully functional setup with strict compliance to technical specifications and safety standards. Our scope includes modular systems, executive furniture, storage solutions, partitions, and applied ergonomics. We execute with a technical process that covers planning and logistics, receiving and inspection, distribution and assembly, levelling and alignment, and final cleaning before handover. Strategic gains are clear: faster operational readiness, reduced downtime, preserved manufacturer warranties, and flexible scheduling, including after-hours interventions.

sub03.title: Excellence Hospitality
sub03.description: Excellence hospitality is where service becomes an art. Beyond physical comfort, true distinction comes from anticipating needs, personalising every detail, and delivering with refined discretion. Our premium service pillars are built around guest understanding, proactive care, and flawless human interaction. We activate high-impact services that transform each stay: proactive concierge support, tailored wellness experiences, and elevated gastronomy adapted to personal preferences. The benefit for your guests is clear and measurable: more peace of mind, a stronger feeling of exclusivity, and lasting memories that drive loyalty and repeat stays.

sub04.title: ATA Carnet Management
sub04.description: The ATA Carnet is the global passport for your temporary goods. It enables entry and re-entry across more than 80 countries without temporary import duties and complex repetitive paperwork. We manage the full specialist cycle: issuance advisory, customs classification validation, guarantee coordination, border logistics guidance, deadline monitoring, and final regularisation with guarantee release. Eligible categories include commercial samples, professional equipment, and trade-fair materials. Strategic outcomes are immediate: direct financial savings, faster and more predictable customs clearance, stronger legal certainty, and smoother access to key international markets.

TermsPage.content:
Last updated: February 2026

1. Object and Scope of Application

These General Terms and Conditions of Sale (GTCS) govern all contractual relations between LA Global Corporation SA (hereinafter "the Provider"), headquartered at Rue de la Sablière 3, 1242 Satigny, Switzerland, and any natural or legal person (hereinafter "the Client") wishing to benefit from our logistics, moving, storage, and asset management services.

By validating a quote or placing an order, the Client accepts these conditions without reservation, which prevail over any other document, unless specifically agreed in writing.

2. Order and Conclusion of Contract

Our services are subject to a personalized quote, established following a precise assessment of your needs. The contract is deemed concluded upon receipt by the Provider of the quote dated and signed by the Client, accompanied, where applicable, by the requested deposit.

Any subsequent modification of the order must be the subject of a written amendment and may result in a price adjustment.

3. Rates and Payment Terms

Our rates are denominated in Swiss Francs (CHF) and are exclusive of tax, unless otherwise stated. Costs related to customs formalities or specific local taxes remain the responsibility of the Client.

  • Deposit: A deposit of 30% to 50% may be required upon signature to confirm the reservation of resources.
  • Balance: The balance is payable upon receipt of the final invoice, according to the terms indicated thereon (generally within 10 or 30 days).

In the event of late payment, default interest may be applied in accordance with prevailing rates.

4. Execution of Services and Delivery

We undertake to execute the services with the utmost care, in accordance with "Swiss Excellence" quality standards.

  • Deadlines: Execution dates are set by mutual agreement. Although we make every effort to respect them, the Provider cannot be held responsible for delays due to external causes (customs, weather, force majeure).
  • Access: The Client must guarantee accessibility to the premises (departure and arrival) and report any technical difficulties (elevator, parking) in advance.

5. Insurance and Liability

LA Global Corporation acts with absolute professional diligence.

  • Liability: We are liable in the event of proven damage resulting directly from our handling, within applicable legal limits.
  • Insurance: We propose and strongly recommend subscribing to our "All-Risk" (Nail-to-Nail) insurance for valuables, fine art, and precious goods, offering optimal coverage beyond basic contractual liabilities.

6. Right of Withdrawal and Cancellation

In compliance with Swiss law, any cancellation by the Client must be notified in writing.

  • More than 30 days before the start: The deposit may be partially refunded, minus administrative fees.
  • Less than 15 days: The deposit remains with the Provider as compensation.
  • Less than 48 hours: The full amount of the service may be due.

7. Data Protection (FADP / GDPR)

We treat your personal data (identity, addresses, inventory) with the strictest confidentiality, solely for the purposes of contract execution. In accordance with the Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) and the GDPR if applicable, you have a right of access and rectification of your data.

8. Applicable Law and Jurisdiction

These conditions are subject to Swiss Law. Any dispute relating to their interpretation or execution will be under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the canton of Geneva, subject to appeal to the Federal Court.
